description: Source code for the IntellijProject class, which builds and manages IntelliJ IDEA project files for Android development, including handling modules, dependencies, and project templates.

classes.name: IntellijProject
classes.description: Main class responsible for building IntelliJ IDEA project files for Android projects, managing modules, dependencies, and templates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes cache, processes modules, and creates project files.

methods.name: createProjectFiles
methods.description: Creates necessary project configuration files and directories.

methods.name: buildFrameWorkModule
methods.description: Handles special building of the framework module.

methods.name: createModulesFile
methods.description: Generates the modules.xml file listing all modules.

methods.name: createVcsFile
methods.description: Creates vcs.xml with version control mappings.

methods.name: createNameFile
methods.description: Creates a .name file with the project name.

methods.name: copyTemplates
methods.description: Copies template files to the project directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the project build process from command line.
